original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_ws AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_ca AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
date_range AS (
  SELECT d1.d_date_sk AS d1_date_sk, d1.d_date AS d1_date, d2.d_date_sk AS d2_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d1
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
  WHERE d1.d_year = 2001
),
warehouse_store AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state
  FROM warehouse w
  INNER JOIN store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered_item fi
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d1_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_ws ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d2_date_sk
INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_ca ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse_store ws_st ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = ws_st.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_quantity
        FROM
            store_sales
    ) ss
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            d_date_sk,
            d_date
        FROM
            date_dim
        WHERE
            d_year = 2001
    ) d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk
        FROM
            item
        WHERE
            i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
            AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
    ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            inv_item_sk,
            inv_date_sk,
            inv_warehouse_sk,
            inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM
            inventory
    ) inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ws_item_sk,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_bill_customer_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk,
            ws_wholesale_cost
        FROM
            web_sales
        WHERE
            ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
    ) ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            d_date_sk,
            d_date
        FROM
            date_dim
        WHERE
            d_year = 2001
    ) d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            w_warehouse_sk,
            w_state
        FROM
            warehouse
    ) w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            s_store_sk,
            s_state
        FROM
            store
    ) s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            c_customer_sk,
            c_current_cdemo_sk,
            c_current_hdemo_sk,
            c_current_addr_sk
        FROM
            customer
    ) c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ca_address_sk
        FROM
            customer_address
        WHERE
            ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
    ) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            cd_demo_sk,
            cd_gender,
            cd_marital_status,
            cd_education_status
        FROM
            customer_demographics
    ) cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            hd_demo_sk,
            hd_vehicle_count
        FROM
            household_demographics
    ) hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
    cnt;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d1.d_date_sk AS d1_date_sk, d2.d_date_sk AS d2_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d1
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)

),

FROM filtered_item
INNER JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ON ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2_date_sk

INNER JOIN filtered_customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk

    AND ws.ws_order_number IS NOT NULL

WITH filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'store' AS source
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  ) all_sources
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON fi.i_brand_id = all_sources.i_brand_id
    AND fi.i_class_id = all_sources.i_class_id
    AND fi.i_category_id = all_sources.i_category_id
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_sk, all_sources.i_brand_id, all_sources.i_class_id, all_sources.i_category_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT all_sources.source) = 3
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT (SUM(sum_sales) / SUM(count_rows)) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
),
target_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1999 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_1999,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_1998

WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item i
  WHERE i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM store_sales ss
      INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
      WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM catalog_sales cs
      INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_sales ws
      INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
      WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  ) x
),
week_seq_1999 AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
  LIMIT 1
),
week_seq_1998 AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  this_year.channel AS ty_channel,

  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN week_seq_1999 w
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)

INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN week_seq_1998 w
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id

),
filtered_item AS (

),
filtered_customer_demographics AS (

SELECT 
  MIN(i.i_item_id) AS min_item_id,
  MIN(s.s_state) AS min_state,
  MIN(ss.ss_quantity) AS min_quantity,

original_query: with customer_total_return as  (select wr_returning_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk  ,ca_state as ctr_state ,wr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(wr_return_amt) as ctr_total_return  from web_returns      ,date_dim      ,customer_address      ,item  where wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk    and d_year =2001    and wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk    and wr_item_sk = i_item_sk    and i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 and 78    and wr_return_amt / wr_return_quantity between 28 and 57  group by wr_returning_customer_sk          ,ca_state, wr_reason_sk)   select  c_customer_id,c_salutation,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_preferred_cust_flag        ,c_birth_day,c_birth_month,c_birth_year,c_birth_country,c_login,c_email_address        ,c_last_review_date_sk,ctr_total_return  from customer_total_return ctr1      ,customer_address      ,customer  where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2  			  from customer_total_return ctr2                   	  where ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state)        and ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk        and ca_state in ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')        and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk        and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk in (3, 31)       and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944  order by c_customer_id,c_salutation,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_preferred_cust_flag                   ,c_birth_day,c_birth_month,c_birth_year,c_birth_country,c_login,c_email_address                   ,c_last_review_date_sk,ctr_total_return limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM web_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
  INNER JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  WHERE wr_reason_sk IN (3, 31)
    AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 28 * wr_return_quantity AND 57 * wr_return_quantity
  GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
),
state_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.threshold
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
INNER JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state IN ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
         c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100

) inv1

      WHEN 0 THEN NULL

  FROM inventory inv
  INNER JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk

    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,

SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE date_diff <= 30) AS "30 days",
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE date_diff > 30 AND date_diff <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE date_diff > 60 AND date_diff <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE date_diff > 90 AND date_diff <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE date_diff > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            d2.d_date_sk AS d2_date_sk,
            d2.d_date AS d2_date
        FROM date_dim d2
        WHERE d2.d_year = 2002 AND d2.d_moy = 8
    ) d2
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d2_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d1
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
        AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d2_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2.d2_date
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_diff
    ) diff
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100

  WHERE d_date = '1999-02-11'

),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev

  INNER JOIN valid_dates vd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk

WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq = (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = '2001-04-16'
  )
),
ss_items AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_item_id AS item_id,
    c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter df ON d.d_date = df.d_date
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
  WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_item_id AS item_id,
    c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter df ON d.d_date = df.d_date
  INNER JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
  WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_item_id AS item_id,
    c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter df ON d.d_date = df.d_date
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
  WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
)
SELECT 
  ss_items.item_id,
  ss_items.birth_year,
  ss_item_rev,
  ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
  cs_item_rev,
  cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
  ws_item_rev,
  ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
  (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM ss_items
INNER JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id
  AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
INNER JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id
  AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
WHERE ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

WITH target_month AS (
  SELECT d_month_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date = '2001-03-21'
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d.d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d
  INNER JOIN target_month tm ON d.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66
),
filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942
),
ss_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id,
         fc.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customers fc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id, fc.c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id,
         fc.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customers fc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id, fc.c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id,
         fc.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customers fc ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id, fc.c_birth_year
)
SELECT ss_items.item_id,
       ss_items.birth_year,
       ss_items.ss_item_rev,
       ss_items.ss_item_rev / ((ss_items.ss_item_rev + cs_items.cs_item_rev + ws_items.ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs_items.cs_item_rev,
       cs_items.cs_item_rev / ((ss_items.ss_item_rev + cs_items.cs_item_rev + ws_items.ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws_items.ws_item_rev,
       ws_items.ws_item_rev / ((ss_items.ss_item_rev + cs_items.cs_item_rev + ws_items.ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,

FROM ss_items
INNER JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
INNER JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year

WITH wss_y AS (
  SELECT 
    d.d_week_seq,
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Sunday') AS sun_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Monday') AS mon_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Tuesday') AS tue_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Wednesday') AS wed_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Thursday') AS thu_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Friday') AS fri_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Saturday') AS sat_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN ss.ss_list_price * 0.65 AND ss.ss_list_price * 0.85
    AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1194 AND 1194 + 11
  GROUP BY d.d_week_seq, ss.ss_store_sk
),
wss_x AS (
  SELECT 
    d.d_week_seq,
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Sunday') AS sun_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Monday') AS mon_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Tuesday') AS tue_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Wednesday') AS wed_sales,

    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Friday') AS fri_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Saturday') AS sat_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN ss.ss_list_price * 0.65 AND ss.ss_list_price * 0.85
    AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1194 + 12 AND 1194 + 23
  GROUP BY d.d_week_seq, ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT 
  s.s_store_name AS s_store_name1,
  s.s_store_id AS s_store_id1,
  wss_y.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1,
  wss_y.sun_sales / wss_x.sun_sales,
  wss_y.mon_sales / wss_x.mon_sales,
  wss_y.tue_sales / wss_x.tue_sales,
  wss_y.wed_sales / wss_x.wed_sales,

FROM wss_y
JOIN store s ON wss_y.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN wss_x ON wss_y.ss_store_sk = wss_x.ss_store_sk

WHERE s.s_state IN ('IL', 'IN', 'MI', 'NC', 'NM', 'OK', 'TN', 'WI')

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk
  FROM catalog_sales, catalog_returns
  WHERE cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
    AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY cs_item_sk
  HAVING sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * sum(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales_1999 AS (
  SELECT 
    i_product_name AS product_name,
    i_item_sk AS item_sk,
    s_store_name AS store_name,
    s_zip AS store_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
    ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
    ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
    ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
    ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
    ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
    ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
    ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
    d1.d_year AS syear,
    d2.d_year AS fsyear,
    d3.d_year AS s2year,
    count(*) AS cnt,
    sum(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
    sum(ss_list_price) AS s2,
    sum(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales
    JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
    JOIN cs_ui ON ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 1999
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
    JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk 
      AND p_channel_email = 'Y' 
      AND p_channel_tv = 'Y' 
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
      AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2 ON c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
      AND ad2.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
    ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,

    JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk 
      AND p_channel_email = 'Y' 
      AND p_channel_tv = 'Y' 
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
      AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2 ON c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
      AND ad2.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk

    JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100

)

  cs1.b_street_name,
  cs1.b_city,

           sum(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3

    INNER JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number

        SELECT cs_item_sk
        FROM catalog_sales
        INNER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
        WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        GROUP BY cs_item_sk

    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'U', 'S') AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree') AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ad2 ON c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk AND ad2.ca_state IN ('KS', 'MN', 'NV')
    INNER JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100

预计算常量表达式'd_moy between 2 and 2+2'为'd_moy between 2 and 4'，避免运行时重复计算
调整连接顺序：先执行customer与customer_address的JOIN(利用ca_state过滤)，再与customer_demographics JOIN，最后处理半连接/反连接，减少中间结果集大小
将date_dim的过滤条件'd_year=1999 and d_moy between 2 and 4'下推到各子查询的date_dim扫描中，并考虑将ss_list_price/ws_list_price/cs_list_price的范围过滤条件与date_dim过滤后再JOIN，减少JOIN前的数据量

original_query: select    cd_gender,   cd_marital_status,   cd_education_status,   count(*) cnt1,   cd_purchase_estimate,   count(*) cnt2,   cd_credit_rating,   count(*) cnt3  from   customer c,customer_address ca,customer_demographics  where   c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk and   ca_state in ('MD','MO','OK') and   cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk   and cd_marital_status in ('W', 'U', 'W')   and cd_education_status in ('Primary', 'Primary') and   exists (select *           from store_sales,date_dim           where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and                 ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and                 d_year = 2002 and                 d_moy between 5 and 5+2                 and ss_list_price between 132 and 221           ) and    (not exists (select *             from web_sales,date_dim             where c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and                   ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and                   d_year = 2002 and                   d_moy between 5 and 5+2                   and ws_list_price between 132 and 221             ) and     not exists (select *             from catalog_sales,date_dim             where c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk and                   cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and                   d_year = 2002 and                   d_moy between 5 and 5+2                   and cs_list_price between 132 and 221)             )  group by cd_gender,           cd_marital_status,           cd_education_status,           cd_purchase_estimate,           cd_credit_rating  order by cd_gender,           cd_marital_status,           cd_education_status,           cd_purchase_estimate,           cd_credit_rating  limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7
),
store_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221
),
web_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221
),
catalog_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  count(*) cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  count(*) cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  count(*) cnt3
FROM
  customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('MD', 'MO', 'OK')
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'U', 'W')
    AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'Primary')
  INNER JOIN store_customers ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_customers ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_customers cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
  AND cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;

应用STRATEGY_CTE_DECOMPOSITION规则，将date_dim的过滤条件(d_year=2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7)提取为CTE，在三个销售表子查询中复用，减少date_dim的重复扫描
简化冗余的IN条件：cd_marital_status in ('W','U','W')简化为in('W','U')，cd_education_status in('Primary','Primary')简化为='Primary'，减少不必要的比较操作
应用JOIN_CONDITION_PUSH和FILTER_INTO_JOIN规则，将ca_state、cd_marital_status、cd_education_status等过滤条件尽早下推到各自表的扫描阶段，减少JOIN前的数据量
应用JOIN_PUSH_TRANSITIVE_PREDICATES规则，从连接条件推导传递性谓词。例如从c.c_current_addr_sk=ca.ca_address_sk和ca_state过滤可以推导出对customer表的间接过滤
预计算常量表达式：d_moy between 5 and 5+2简化为d_moy between 5 and 7，ss_list_price/ws_list_price/cs_list_price的范围条件统一为BETWEEN 132 AND 221

original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'U'   and cd_dep_count between 5 and 7   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_date_d2 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM filtered_date_d1)
),
filtered_date_d3 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date > (SELECT MIN(d_date) + INTERVAL '3 day' FROM filtered_date_d1)
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_order_number, cs_quantity, cs_promo_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_ship_date_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_bill_hdemo_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_customer_demographics AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U'
    AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
),
core_join AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_item_desc,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq,
    cs.cs_promo_sk,
    cs.cs_item_sk,
    cs.cs_order_number
  FROM filtered_catalog_sales cs
  JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_d3 d3 ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
  JOIN filtered_item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN filtered_household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN inventory inv ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_d2 d2 ON inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
  JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
)
SELECT 
  cj.i_item_desc,
  cj.w_warehouse_name,
  cj.d_week_seq,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM core_join cj
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p ON cj.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cj.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND cj.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
GROUP BY cj.i_item_desc, cj.w_warehouse_name, cj.d_week_seq
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, cj.i_item_desc, cj.w_warehouse_name, cj.d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 将catalog_sales表的cs_wholesale_cost过滤条件(BETWEEN 80 AND 100)尽早应用，减少后续连接的数据量。同时将item表的i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')条件下推，这两个条件的选择性较高，可以显著减少参与连接的行数。

调整连接顺序：优先连接小表和高选择性过滤条件的表。建议顺序：1)先连接warehouse(10行)、household_demographics(7200行，hd_buy_potential='1001-5000')、customer_demographics(cd_marital_status='U'且cd_dep_count范围过滤)；2)再连接date_dim d1(d_year=2001过滤)；3)然后连接已过滤的item和catalog_sales；4)最后连接inventory和其他表。这样可以在早期阶段大幅减少中间结果集。
将d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq的连接条件下推，并考虑将date_dim d2与inventory的连接提前评估。由于inventory是最大的表(1.33亿行)，通过d2的d_week_seq条件可以减少inventory的扫描范围。
将d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'条件转换为可索引的形式。可以先计算d1.d_date的范围(基于d_year=2001)，然后将条件改写为d3.d_date > [计算出的最小日期] + 3，使得d3表的过滤可以更早执行。
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion和catalog_returns的处理：由于这两个LEFT JOIN只在SELECT的聚合函数中使用(判断p_promo_sk是否为NULL和cr_item_sk的存在性)，可以考虑将它们转换为子查询或使用EXISTS/NOT EXISTS，避免LEFT JOIN产生的笛卡尔积效应。
在连接早期阶段进行列裁剪，只保留WHERE条件、JOIN条件和最终SELECT需要的列。特别是对于catalog_sales、inventory等大表，减少传递的列数可以降低内存和IO开销。

original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '>10000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'W'   and cd_dep_count between 4 and 6   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_cs AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_ship_date_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_bill_hdemo_sk, cs_promo_sk, cs_order_number, cs_quantity
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM customer_demographics cd
      WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM household_demographics hd
      WHERE hd.hd_demo_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM item i
      WHERE i.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    )
)
SELECT
  i.i_item_desc,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  d1.d_week_seq,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM warehouse w
INNER JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_cs cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
INNER JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
INNER JOIN filtered_d1 d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
  AND inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
GROUP BY i.i_item_desc, w.w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i.i_item_desc, w.w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
LIMIT 100

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 调整连接顺序：优先连接小表warehouse(10行)和高选择性维度表customer_demographics(cd_marital_status='W')、household_demographics(hd_buy_potential='>10000')，再连接item(利用item_pkey索引+i_category过滤)，然后连接date_dim(d1、d2、d3)使用Hash Join避免排序，最后连接大表catalog_sales和inventory。具体实现：将FROM子句重排为 warehouse → customer_demographics → household_demographics → item → date_dim(d1) → date_dim(d2) → catalog_sales → inventory → date_dim(d3)，确保小表驱动大表，减少中间结果集。

将d1.d_week_seq=d2.d_week_seq的连接从Merge Join改为Hash Join：通过CTE预计算d1过滤后的week_seq集合(WITH filtered_d1 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year=2001))，然后d2直接Hash Join到filtered_d1.d_week_seq，消除Sort算子的8219 cost开销。

将inventory的Nested Loop连接改为Hash Join：在连接条件inv.inv_date_sk=d2.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk=cs.cs_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand<cs.cs_quantity中，先通过d2.d_date_sk和cs.cs_item_sk构建Hash表，再扫描inventory进行探测，避免逐行Nested Loop的6342 cost开销。

简化LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns：当前LEFT JOIN仅用于关联但未在SELECT、WHERE或HAVING中使用cr的任何列(仅用cs.cs_promo_sk判断)，可将LEFT JOIN改为NOT EXISTS反连接或直接移除(若业务逻辑允许)。若必须保留关联语义，改为SEMI JOIN: WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_item_sk=cs.cs_item_sk AND cr.cr_order_number=cs.cs_order_number)，减少连接开销。
在item子查询中保持索引访问：将当前的全表扫描(Seq Scan cost 7553)改为索引扫描，通过在子查询中仅投影i_item_sk和i_item_desc，并利用item_pkey索引，然后在外层应用i_category过滤(或创建covering index on item(i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_category))，恢复Index Scan访问路径。

优化catalog_sales的过滤条件：cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37的选择性较低，但可结合其他高选择性条件(cs_bill_cdemo_sk、cs_bill_hdemo_sk、cs_item_sk)提前过滤。将这些连接条件转换为EXISTS子查询或SEMI JOIN，在catalog_sales扫描阶段就应用维度表过滤，减少后续连接的行数。例如：WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_demographics cd WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk=cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AND cd.cd_marital_status='W' AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6)。
消除date_dim的冗余排序：当前d1.d_week_seq的Sort(cost 6083)是为Merge Join准备的，改用Hash Join后可完全消除此排序。同时检查最终的ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq是否可以利用索引或通过增量TopN算法优化(因有LIMIT 100)。

简化CASE WHEN聚合表达式：当前SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)和SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)可改为COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 END)和COUNT(cs.cs_promo_sk)，减少表达式计算开销。同时COUNT(*)可直接从聚合结果派生(no_promo + promo)，避免重复计数。

original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'   and d1.d_year = 2000   and cd_marital_status = 'S'   and cd_dep_count between 6 and 8   and i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 69 AND 89 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
  i_item_desc,
  w_warehouse_name,
  d1.d_week_seq,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p_promo_sk IS NULL) AS no_promo,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL) AS promo,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM
  catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 2000
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
  INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
  INNER JOIN inventory inv ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
  INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
  INNER JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 6 AND 8
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
  LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
WHERE
  cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 69 AND 89
GROUP BY
  i_item_desc,
  w_warehouse_name,
  d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY
  total_cnt DESC,
  i_item_desc,
  w_warehouse_name,

with base_date as (
  select d_date_sk
  from date_dim
  where d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date)
                   and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
),
base_item as (
  select i_item_sk
  from item
  where i_current_price > 50
    and i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
base_promo as (
  select p_promo_sk
  from promotion
  where p_channel_email = 'N'
    and p_channel_tv = 'N'
    and p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    and p_channel_press = 'N'
    and p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr as (
  select s_store_id as store_id,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from store_sales
  inner join base_date on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join store on ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  inner join base_item on ss_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on ss_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join store_returns on (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  where ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by s_store_id
),
csr as (
  select cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id,
         sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
         sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from catalog_sales
  inner join base_date on cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join catalog_page on cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  inner join base_item on cs_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on cs_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk and cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  where cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
  select web_site_id,
         sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from web_sales
  inner join base_date on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join web_site on ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  inner join base_item on ws_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on ws_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join web_returns on (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk and ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  where ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by web_site_id
)
select channel,
       id,
       sum(sales) as sales,
       sum(returns) as returns,
       sum(profit) as profit
from (
  select 'store channel' as channel,
         'store' || store_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from ssr
  union all
  select 'catalog channel' as channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from csr
  union all
  select 'web channel' as channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from wsr
) x
group by rollup (channel, id)
order by channel, id
limit 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Home', 'Men')
),
filtered_promos AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT s_store_id AS store_id,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promos ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promos ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT web_site_id,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promos ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM catalog_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
state_threshold AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  ca_street_number,
  ca_street_name,
  ca_street_type,
  ca_suite_number,
  ca_city,
  ca_county,
  ca_state,
  ca_zip,
  ca_country,
  ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN state_threshold st ON ctr1.ctr_state = st.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > st.threshold
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'IL'
ORDER BY 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  ca_street_number,
  ca_street_name,
  ca_street_type,
  ca_suite_number,
  ca_city,
  ca_county,
  ca_state,
  ca_zip,
  ca_country,
  ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type,
  ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH ctr_base AS (
  SELECT

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
),
filtered_ws AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_order_number, ws_web_page_sk, ws_quantity, ws_sales_price, ws_net_profit, ws_sold_date_sk

),
cd_pairs AS (
  SELECT cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_sk, cd2.cd_demo_sk AS cd2_sk,
         cd1.cd_marital_status AS marital_status,
         cd1.cd_education_status AS education_status
  FROM customer_demographics cd1
  JOIN customer_demographics cd2
    ON cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
   AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
  WHERE (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
     OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College')

FROM

SELECT
  substring(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20),
  sm_type,
  cc_name,
  SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS "30 days",
  SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 30 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
  SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 60 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
  SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 90 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
  SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      d_date_sk
    FROM
      date_dim
    WHERE
      d_month_seq BETWEEN 1193 AND 1216
  ) d
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      cs_ship_date_sk,
      cs_sold_date_sk,
      cs_warehouse_sk,
      cs_ship_mode_sk,
      cs_call_center_sk
    FROM
      catalog_sales
    WHERE
      cs_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 106
  ) cs ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      w_warehouse_sk,
      w_warehouse_name
    FROM
      warehouse
    WHERE
      w_gmt_offset = -5
  ) w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      sm_ship_mode_sk,
      sm_type
    FROM
      ship_mode
    WHERE
      sm_type = 'TWO DAY'
  ) sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      cc_call_center_sk,
      cc_name
    FROM
      call_center
    WHERE
      cc_class = 'small'
  ) cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
GROUP BY
  substring(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20),
  sm_type,
  cc_name
ORDER BY
  substring(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20),
  sm_type,
  cc_name
LIMIT 100
